title: 12/18/20 - Software Updates
text:
## 12/18/20 - Software Updates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000076514
We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.
We updated the links in the lead notification emails sent to the Admin of the site to make sure clicking on the link will log the Admin in to the site the lead was submitted to rather than the Default Login Website of the Admin account.
We updated the cancelation process so that when a member is set to "Cancelled" in the "Quick Edit" modal on the Search Members page in the Admin, the member's billing subscription and any unpaid invoices will be cancelled as well.
We updated the logic of the Multi-Member Manager Add-On so that sub accounts cannot be set as "Active" unless the parent account has the "Active" status. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Body datatable Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Edit
We fixed an issue which was preventing the logged-in member's image from displaying correctly in the header of the site in some cases.
The Media Manager tool in the Admin now supports uploading files with the .xml file extension.
We updated the areas where youtube video thumbnails are displayed to support more youtube URL formats. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Body datatable Bootstrap Theme - Display - Related Posts by Category Bootstrap Theme - Function - Add to Favorites Button Bootstrap Theme - HEAD
The "Post a new comment.." text when using the Community Comments Add-On is now a text label. Text Label Involved: comments_new_comment
We updated the layout and fixed several minor technical issues on the Manage Posts page in the Admin.
The "on" text on the Leads details page in the Member Dashboard area is now a text label. Text Label Involved: on_label
The "Print" text on the Post details page is now a text label. Text Label Involved: print_label
The Filter By Star Rating Add-On is now compatible with text labels. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Module - Reviews Search Text Label Involved: reviews_any_rating star_rating rating_criteria_overall
The confirmation alerts when uploading photos to a multi-photo post are now text labels. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Photo Albums Upload Form Text Labels Involved: error_label form_connection_error swal_continue system_success_label swal_warning image_upload_error
We updated the Smart List exporting functionality to make the queries used in the tool more secure.
We fixed an issue which was causing the lead preview email template to erroneously include the email and phone data in the email when manually matching members through the Admin in some cases.
We improved the Form Manager backend validation in order to prevent fields from being considered as required when they are set to not be required in the Form Manager. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Save Form
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Member Login module to work properly when using text labels with single or double quotes in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Login Page
We fixed an issue which was causing the Date options on the "Order Results By" Post Type setting to sort results in reverse order on Post Results pages in some cases. Widget Involved: Search - Post - Search Query
The "Request More Reviews" text on the Reviews details page in the Member Dashboard area is now a text label. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Reviews Details Page Text Label Involved: request_more_recommendation
We fixed an issue which was affecting the layout of the Compose Email modal in the Admin, causing the Froala WYSIWYG toolbar to get stuck when scrolling in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "CTA Button Color" setting in the Hero Section tab from saving when editing Web Pages in some cases.
